summary: Runtime trace evidence is now an inspectable registry, not just a stored array plus a coverage ratio. The service, operator status, and run report can all name traced targets, missing risky targets, and open missing-runtime-trace gaps.

verification.command: git diff --check -- src/domain/types.ts src/runtime/autonomous-execution.ts src/runtime/runtime-trace-registry.ts src/core/service.ts src/admin/status.ts src/admin/report.ts tests/service.test.ts tests/status-report.test.ts tests/report-command.test.ts

release_readiness.reason: This slice only extends typed runtime/admin evidence surfaces, and the new behavior is covered by focused service, status, and report regressions plus typecheck and diff-hygiene validation.

residual_risk: Continuation actions are still narrower than the redesign target; the registry makes missing trace evidence explicit but does not broaden runtime-native continuation yet.
Compressed-context generation is still only a checkpoint field contract; operational compaction remains the next slice.
